prompt:
Create a premium photorealistic architectural film storyboard contact sheet, 2 columns by 4 rows, eight 16:9 cinematic panels, portrait overall layout, clean white gutters. Heading "FROM THE OPENING UP" and small subtitle "CGC / INSTALLATION FILM CONCEPT". Number panels 01 through 08 only, no other panel text. Same single-story Southern California commercial shell in every panel: white stucco facade, recessed rectangular storefront opening approximately 24 feet wide and 10 feet high, flat graphite fascia, pale concrete sidewalk, same square white pier at each side. Final design slim graphite aluminum storefront, one continuous horizontal transom, fixed glass bays and a single glass entrance door at the right side. Bright neutral daylight from upper left, white/graphite/steel-blue reflections. No changing building, brick, logos, signage or landscaping.
01 wide straight-on rough opening, concrete curb and white jambs, interior unfinished, no aluminum frame or glass yet.
02 close detail of lower jamb, graphite sill receiver being positioned by two gloved hands; opening still empty.
03 medium view two adult installers in plain work clothing, hard hats, eye protection and gloves supporting a rigid vertical graphite aluminum jamb, already seated on sill, aligning it upright; no glass yet.
04 wider same opening now framed with fixed bays, transom and right door opening, glass bays empty. Clean rigid consistent frame geometry.
05 close medium view at one fixed bay: two properly supported adult installers using suction handles on one upright transparent rigid glass lite, its lower edge just above the frame pocket; hands plausible and kept away from pinch point. Modest glass size, no overhead suspended load.
06 macro completed fixed-glass perimeter, gloved hand drawing a short continuous neat sealant bead along a straight joint, aluminum and glass fixed; not a technical instruction diagram.
07 medium right entrance: two installers supporting one rectangular graphite-framed glass door leaf upright near its jamb with suction handles, bottom supported; fixed surrounding glazing already installed.
08 wide three-quarter final same facade completely glazed, right door closed, clean interior lights, no people or tools, credible glass reflections and transparency.
Visually compelling restrained trade documentary, crisp aluminum geometry, real installation progression, not glowing CGI assembly, no flying panels, no ghost workers, no floating tools, no animated lines, no marketing stats. This is an illustrative storyboard not an actual CGC project photograph.
